title: 雅思作文 #1 · 长句中译英（Task 1 & Task 2 模板句）
goal: 作文长句中译英：大作文观点句 + 小作文图表句，批改时纠正语法。每句一个高频结构。

questions.prompt:
翻译成英文：
一些人认为政府应该把更多资金投入到公共交通上，而不是修建更多的高速公路。
要求：①「资金被投入」用被动语态 ②用 rather than 对比 ③用上 invest...in 搭配

answer.rubric: ①被动 be invested in public transport；②rather than building more motorways（平行结构）；③时态一致（should 情态 + 原形）；④忠实原文

questions.explanation: 示范句：Some people believe that more money should be invested in public transport rather than building more motorways.

questions.prompt:
翻译成英文：
从 2010 年到 2020 年，上网课的学生数量稳步上升，而传统课堂的出勤率则略有下降。
要求：①图表过去时（period 已结束）②用 while 对比两个趋势 ③用上趋势词汇 steadily / slightly

answer.rubric: ①一般过去时 rose/increased/declined；②while 对比从句；③趋势词汇：steadily increased / slightly declined；④the number of 主谓一致

questions.explanation: 示范句：Between 2010 and 2020, the number of students taking online courses increased steadily, while attendance at traditional classes declined slightly.
questions.knowledge_point: 写作 Task 1 趋势描述

questions.prompt:
翻译成英文：
过度依赖社交媒体可能会导致年轻人失去面对面交流的能力。
要求：①用 over-reliance on 开头 ②用 lead to ③用上 lose the ability to do 结构

answer.rubric: ①over-reliance on social media 作主语；②lead to + 名词/动名词；③lose the ability to communicate face to face；④may 情态 + 原形

questions.explanation: 示范句：Over-reliance on social media may lead to young people losing the ability to communicate face to face.
